commits.notes: Frozen repository-owned synthetic reference workflow, domain invariants, fixtures, and self-contained validator.
Reverified exact archive digests against downloaded upstream releases.
Reverified the Go engine and supervisor, including occupied ports, child exit and startup cancellation.
Version 1 manifest validation verified through the Go engine and browser with typed error, request limit and restart coverage.

Recoverable local authoritative writes port implemented and verified with single writer exclusivity, bounded state, atomic visible manifest, idempotency, auth precedence, path containment, streaming recovery, interrupted/disk-full recovery and negative cases.

Clean-checkout Go engine build, fail-closed CI test collection (.github/workflows/runtime.yml), test discovery documentation (docs/engineering/ENGINE_TESTS.md), and C06 security/integrity integration tests verified.
Analyst case and evidence aggregates (internal/cases/model.go) enforce single-case evidence ownership, explicit cross-case access rejection, prerequisite checks, and restart recovery.

Bounded streaming evidence upload into isolated quarantine with SHA-256 hashing, path/symlink rejection, interrupt/retry safety, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/evidence/upload.go and tests/upload_test.go.

Durable content-addressed blob commit before atomic evidence manifest sealing, hash-mismatch abort, boundary-crash orphan recovery, lost-ACK idempotency, bounded retries, quota checks, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/evidence/seal.go and tests/seal_test.go.

Read-only sealed byte and manifest integrity verification with distinct failure classification (1-byte digest_mismatch vs size_mismatch vs missing_file), Ed25519 signer trust/expiry enforcement, monotonic anti-rollback AuthorityTracker, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/evidence/verify.go and tests/integrity_test.go.

Append-only attributable custody ledger with mandatory actor/timestamp/reason records, SHA-256 cryptographic hash chaining, anti-rewrite invariants, restart durability, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/custody/events.go and tests/custody_test.go.

Independent verification of signed externally stored custody roots, outside signer trust allowlisting, Ed25519 signature validation, anti-rollback CheckpointTracker, FileCheckpointStore adapter, and ledger rewrite detection verified in internal/custody/checkpoints.go and tests/checkpoint_test.go.

Legal hold blocking of deletion and retention expiration under concurrency, durable attribution and reason auditing, restart recovery, and sealed-byte immutability verified in internal/holds/service.go and tests/hold_test.go.

Fixed non-executing CSV and JSON analyzer interface, shipped allowlist enforcement, sealed evidence read-only verification, and deterministic config/tool provenance verified in internal/analyzers/provider.go and tests/analyzer_contract_test.go.

Bounded analyzer sandbox isolation, private 0700 scratch allocation with quota tracking, outbound network interception (ErrNetworkForbidden), execution deadline aborts, and read-only sealed evidence byte verification verified in internal/analyzers/sandbox.go and tests/isolation_test.go.

Derived artifact manifests bound to sealed input hashes, allowlisted tool version, deterministic config hash, and optional Ed25519 attestation with atomic staging, restart recovery, and read-only source verification in internal/artifacts/manifest.go and tests/provenance_test.go.

Timestamp normalization preserving raw_timestamp and confidence while leaving unknown zones, RFC3339 -00:00, DST fall-back ambiguity (candidate_utcs), and DST spring-forward gaps explicit rather than fabricating UTC, plus atomic TimeStore import/restart recovery in internal/timeline/time.go and tests/time_test.go.

Stable derived EventIdentity calculation (canonical JSON + SHA-256 excluding volatile run/slice order), deduplicating EventIndexStore with C16/C17/SealStore integration, deterministic sorting, atomic persistence, and restart recovery in internal/timeline/index.go and tests/timeline_test.go.

Bounded local timeline index search (MaxResults, MaxScanEvents, ExpandDepth, MaxExpandDegree, MaxVisitedNodes, cycle detection, context deadline/cancellation) and deterministic atomic RebuildCaseIndex from verified C16 derived artifacts and immutable SealStore inputs in internal/timeline/search.go and tests/search_test.go.

Epistemic separation of analyst hypotheses (requiring non-empty Author and Rationale, IsSourceEvidence=false, RecordKind=analyst_hypothesis) from cryptographically bound ObservedFacts (backed by SealStore and EventIndexStore) in internal/findings/notes.go and tests/facts_test.go; rejects UI-label/flag promotion and persisted tampering across restarts.

Evidence Integrity & Custody UI on #evidence route (apps/web/src/pages/Evidence.tsx, apps/web/src/main.tsx, apps/web/src/styles.css) wired via local relay (scripts/serve-web.mjs) to Go engine POST /api/v1/evidence-integrity/inspect (cmd/breachatlas/integrity.go); visibly displays verified/incomplete_seal/verification_failed states and custody chains, escapes all user strings via JSX text nodes, supports keyboard table inspection, and handles empty/invalid/interrupted/unavailable states cleanly at 360px (verified in apps/web/tests/evidence.spec.ts and cmd/breachatlas/integrity_test.go).

Timezone-aware Timeline and Analyst Notes UI on #timeline route (apps/web/src/pages/Timeline.tsx, apps/web/src/main.tsx, apps/web/src/styles.css) wired via local relay (scripts/serve-web.mjs) to Go engine POST /api/v1/timeline/inspect (cmd/breachatlas/timeline.go); makes raw timestamps, normalized UTC times (or explicit unresolved/DST ambiguity without fake UTC), and confidence inspectable in both timeline and accessible table views, separates non-evidence analyst notes with author/rationale, escapes all strings via JSX text nodes, and handles empty/invalid/interrupted/unavailable states cleanly at 360px (verified in apps/web/tests/timeline.spec.ts and cmd/breachatlas/timeline_test.go).

Portable self-contained DFIR export bundle packaging in internal/export/package.go and tests/export_test.go; binds verified SealStore evidence blobs read-only, custody event chains, verified signed Custody Checkpoints, verified derived ArtifactStore files, optional timeline and separated non-evidence hypotheses, FileChecksums, BundleDigest, and optional Ed25519 signature with atomic staging/restart recovery.

Standalone offline verifier CLI (cmd/verify/main.go) and domain verification engine (internal/export/verify.go) verifying portable evidence, custody chains, checkpoints, derived artifacts, and timeline raw timestamps without running a server or network connection; validates all file checksums, sealed blobs, and custody roots, distinguishes unsigned vs trusted signatures, and rejects tampered bytes, missing files, corrupted signatures, and untrusted signers (verified in tests/offline_verify_test.go).

Explicit retention and evidence destruction store in internal/retention/destroy.go prohibiting automatic raw-evidence TTL (ErrAutoRawTTLForbidden), enforcing holds.Service legal hold precedence across restarts (ErrHoldActive), recording immutable cryptographic DELETED_TOMBSTONE records with optional Ed25519 attestation, atomic staging/restart recovery, idempotency, and append-only audit logs without modifying sealed source bytes (verified in tests/retention_test.go).

Cross-store case consistency verification, portable export bundle restoration, and deterministic derived timeline index rebuild in internal/recovery/restore.go, internal/artifacts/manifest.go, internal/custody/events.go, and internal/evidence/seal.go without custody rewrite or sealed-byte mutation; verified against boundary crashes, ACK-loss idempotent replay, quota/retry/disk-full limits, lock contention, and tamper/traversal/symlink negative cases in tests/restore_test.go and documented in docs/evidence/restore-template.md.

Cross-surface abuse, XSS/import, and authorization boundaries (N27) verified across #workspace, #evidence, #timeline, #roadmap, scripts/serve-web.mjs, cmd/breachatlas HTTP endpoints, and domain/storage stores; hardened case-insensitive forged header checks and blobs/ path containment/symlink rejection in internal/storage/adapter.go, all-values Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site/forged-header enforcement in cmd/breachatlas/main.go, and normalized-path /api* + /runtime-config.json enforcement in scripts/serve-web.mjs, documented in docs/security/THREAT_MODEL.md and tests/release/security-matrix.md, and verified in tests/security_boundaries_test.go, cmd/breachatlas/main_test.go, and tests/browser/security.spec.ts.

Bounded operational target and overload workloads (N28) measured and verified on local host across quarantine & seal, custody & checkpoint, timeline index & search, export & verify, and restore & rebuild (tests/performance_test.go, scripts/benchmark-local.mjs, tests/scenarios/target-workload.json, tests/fixtures/breachatlas/C28); confirmed pipeline p50/p95/max latencies within bounds (p50 ~21.1ms, p95 ~22.6ms against 250ms/1000ms thresholds), peak RSS well under 1024 MiB, zero disk leakage, 9 overload saturation failure modes (upload_too_large, query_limit_exceeded, context_canceled, lock_busy, disk_full), and sealed source byte immutability, with published limits recorded in docs/evidence/performance.json.

Separated web liveness (/healthz) from Go engine, authoritative local storage, and required provider readiness (/readyz and /api/v1/diagnostics) with bounded (64 entries / 16384 bytes) secret-redacted diagnostic logging in cmd/breachatlas/diagnostics.go, cmd/breachatlas/main.go, scripts/serve-web.mjs, ops/web/runtime-config.json, apps/web/src/lib/runtime-config.mjs, and ops/diagnostics.md; verified missing storage prerequisites, symlinked roots, unavailable providers, unreachable engine, synthetic secret sentinel redaction, ring buffer eviction, restart recovery, and sealed 0440 byte immutability across cmd/breachatlas/diagnostics_test.go, tests/diagnostics_readiness_test.go, and tests/web/engine-readiness.test.mjs.

Proved full local usability from real clean git clone -> npm run setup -> npm start (N30): wired live Go workflow engine handlers (cmd/breachatlas/workflow.go) and accessible #workflow UI (apps/web/src/pages/Workflow.tsx) with relay routing (scripts/serve-web.mjs), extended scripts/clone-smoke.mjs while keeping the web-only proof labeled separately, verified all 8 reference workflow steps, legal hold precedence (409 hold_active), tampered-byte detection, unavailable-provider/missing-storage/malformed-JSON failures, offline verification without a running server via dist/bin/verify, restart persistence, derived index rebuild, and bundle restore preserving immutable sealed bytes in tests/browser/clone-to-value.spec.ts and tests/clone_acceptance_test.go, recording acceptance evidence in docs/evidence/private-install.json.

Packaged complete reproducible open-source release artifacts (N31): compiled Go loopback engine (bin/breachatlas) and standalone offline verifier (bin/verify) via -trimpath -buildvcs=false alongside Vite web assets (web/), local relay/supervisor scripts (scripts/serve-web.mjs, scripts/start-local.mjs), hardened private-host templates (ops/web/nginx.conf.template, ops/web/service.systemd), offline contracts/runtime requirements (contracts/, ops/runtime-requirements.json, docs/engineering/toolchain-lock.json), bit-for-bit reproducible source tar.gz and BUILD_RECIPE.json (scripts/package-source.mjs), SPDX-2.3 SBOM (80 packages validated against permissive OSS allowlist), complete THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, SHA256SUMS.txt, and Ed25519-signed release.json provenance with atomic staging, crash recovery, lost-ACK replay idempotency, conflict/quota rejection, and sealed source immutability verified in internal/release/package.go, internal/release/package_test.go, tests/release_packaging_test.go, tests/web/oss-tooling.test.mjs, scripts/package.sh, and scripts/package-web.mjs.

Hardened zero-domain local launch and optional private TLS hosting (N32): exported isLoopbackHost, isLoopbackAuthority, and validateLoopbackEngineTarget in scripts/serve-web.mjs to fail closed on non-loopback engine upstream targets, enforced cross-site/origin rejection across all HTTP routes while pinning upstream relay Host headers and Cache-Control: no-store, documented zero-domain local operation and optional deny-all Nginx/systemd TLS ingress in infra/deployment.md and docs/engineering/CLONE_TO_RUN.md, and verified loopback, Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site, forged-header, Cache-Control, missing-prerequisite, unavailable-provider, malformed-JSON, restart, and 0440 sealed-byte immutability invariants in tests/web/network-boundaries.test.mjs and tests/network_boundaries_test.go with evidence recorded in docs/evidence/domain.json and docs/evidence/C32.json.

Verified keyboard, mobile/desktop (360px and 1440px), failure handling, and N-1 export compatibility (N33): added accessible Sealed Evidence Table and Workflow Timeline Table equivalents in apps/web/src/pages/Workflow.tsx and responsive 360px input sizing in apps/web/src/styles.css; verified full 8-step keyboard workflow, zero horizontal overflow, empty/invalid/interrupted/provider-outage handling in tests/browser/full-workflow-accessibility.spec.ts; verified N-1 compatible bundle verification, modified-byte, missing-evidence, untrusted-signer, expired/stale/replayed checkpoint authority anti-rollback, interrupted restore rollback, and 0440 sealed-byte immutability in tests/ux_compatibility_test.go; recorded observed Linux x86_64 platform UX evidence in docs/evidence/ux.json and docs/evidence/C33.json.

Frozen local privacy limits, data locations, export/deletion/retention/backup/recovery rules, supported Linux x86_64 profile, and dependency/maintenance policy (N38): authored docs/release/SERVICE_POLICY.md and docs/release/MAINTENANCE.md, and verified policy completeness, SealStore manifest-boundary crash recovery, idempotent replay, quota exhaustion (ErrStorageQuotaExceeded), and sealed-byte immutability in tests/release_policy_test.go and tests/fixtures/breachatlas/C38/.
